items.title: Buy Robinhood Markets Stock, Analyst Says. Plus, Intuit and 4 More Stocks.
items.summary: RESEARCH REPORTS These reports, excerpted and edited by Barron’s, were issued recently by investment and research firms. The reports are a sampling of analysts’ thinking; they should not be considered the views or recommendations of Barron’s.

items.title: Q2 Earnings Highs And Lows: Intuit (NASDAQ:INTU) Vs The Rest Of The Finance and HR Software Stocks
items.summary: Wrapping up Q2 earnings, we look at the numbers and key takeaways for the finance and hr software stocks, including Intuit (NASDAQ:INTU) and its peers.

items.title: Adobe Pulls Back, Then Recovers as CEO Handoff Meets Soft Q4 Outlook; Intuit and ServiceNow Hold Steady
items.summary: Adobe beat estimates and raised its full-year outlook, yet the stock still stumbled out of the gate Friday morning. A soft Q4 guide and a simultaneous CEO and CFO transition are now weighing on a franchise already down 30% for the year.

items.title: Intuit CFO outlines bid to build an ‘end-to-end consumer platform’
items.summary: Speaking at a Goldman Sachs conference on Thursday, Sandeep Aujla said Inuit aims to retake market share in the consumer tax space and attract business customers.

items.title: Meta Platforms Settles Major Lawsuit, Pays $18 Billion
items.summary: The team digs into the details of the settlement and how it will impact Meta.

items.title: S&P 500 falls as AI worries hit software makers
items.summary: By Noel Randewich and Niket Nishant Sept 8 (Reuters) - The S&P 500 ended lower on Tuesday, with Salesforce and other software makers losing ground, while hostilities in the Middle East lifted oil

items.title: Adobe Sinks 7% as Internal CEO Pick Lands Ahead of Earnings, Workday Falls 4%
items.summary: Adobe named an internal successor days before a scheduled earnings report, and investors are not treating the timing as a coincidence. The question hanging over the stock is whether the new CEO can answer what the AI era actually means for the company's core business.

items.title: Software Stocks Are Back. 2 Winners, 2 Losers—and Salesforce.
items.summary: Salesforce and other software stocks have impressed the market this earnings season but investors need to be careful about which ones to back.
